text:
Lina: quick sync — ACME asked to remove the softcap grace for Premium and get guaranteed surge capacity. they want this in pilot. how do we classify? addon or tier change?
Ajay: my take — make it an "addon: surge-reserve" for pilot. easier contract-wise and avoids rewriting SLAs for all Premium customers.
Maria: agree on addon, but we need clear launch gates: docs, per-route throttling, billing proration. last pilot had edge cases on billing.
Tom: finance flag — if we call it addon we must define proration rules and how credits apply. do we bill based on reserved tokens or actual usage? preference: reserved tokens + overage.
Lina: reserved tokens + overage sounds good. need to define soft-exit window (how long customer can return capacity without penalty). propose 14 days.
Ajay: 14d ok. also recommend priority lane tag so routing can favor addon customers. ops needs a fallback plan if pool exhausted.
ops-bot: FYI: current autoscale policy will not isolate burst capacity. ops action required: add policy "surge-reserve-pool" + hard fallback -> degrade to best-effort models.
Maria: launch checklist suggestion:
- SLA doc update (addendum)
- Playbook: degrade path + customer comms
- Telemetry: per-customer latency+errors + reserved vs used tokens
- Billing: reserved token accounting + proration rules
- Legal: contract clause for soft-exit 14d
Lina: ordering priority — engineering needs clear product spec. I'll draft and include sample pricing snippet.
Maria: snippet idea:
```json
{
  "addon": "surge_reserve",
  "price": "$X/month for Y tokens",
  "billing": "reserved_tokens + overage_per_token"
}
```
Ajay: can we add a pilot discount? say 30% for first 3 months. keeps them engaged.
Tom: finance ok with 30% pilot discount if we cap the total reserved capacity exposure to $50k per customer.
Lina: decision: addon "surge_reserve", 14d soft-exit, reserved+overage billing, pilot 30% discount w/ $50k exposure cap.
Maria: next steps: Lina to post PRD -> eng can assign. Ops to scope surge-reserve-pool changes. Legal to draft contract addendum.
Ajay: I'll prepare customer comms template and add Qs for sales negotiation.
ops-bot: noted: created ticket INF-4921 for surge-reserve pool work.
Lina: thanks everyone. tagging @Tom @Maria for final signoff by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
